Along the oblique line toward the N direction there is a shorter shadow length OP, and along the oblique line toward the S direction there is a longer shadow length OQ, indicating that the noon tree shadows at the same place on the two solstices point in opposite directions respectively. Estimated according to the ratio of tree height to shadow length in the figure, the solar zenith angle corresponding to the short shadow OP is about 12.5°, and the solar zenith angle corresponding to the long shadow OQ is about 34.5°. In the figure, the short shadow OP points north, indicating that on that day the sun is on the south side; the long shadow OQ points south, indicating that on the other solstice the sun is on the north side, which conforms to the situation in low-latitude areas of the Southern Hemisphere. Therefore the local latitude is 11°S.

method.method_draft: Describe the image, then identify OP as the short northward solstice noon shadow and OQ as the long southward solstice noon shadow. Estimate each shadow’s zenith angle by comparing it with the vertical tree height: OP corresponds to roughly 12.5° and OQ to roughly 34.5°. Since opposite solstice shadows mean the site lies between the tropics, set the smaller zenith angle to 23.5°−|φ| and the larger to 23.5°+|φ|. Solving gives |φ|=11°. Because the longer shadow is toward the south when the Sun is to the north and the shorter one is toward the north when the Sun is to the south, the site is in the Southern Hemisphere: 11°S.

按图中树高与影长的比例估算，短影 OP 对应的太阳天顶角约为 12.5°，长影 OQ 对应的太阳天顶角约为 34.5°。二至日正午影子方向相反，说明该地位于南北回归线之间。设当地纬度绝对值为 |φ|，则较小天顶角为 23.5°－|φ|，较大天顶角为 23.5°＋|φ|。由 23.5°－|φ|≈12.5°，或 23.5°＋|φ|≈34.5°，得 |φ|≈11°。图中短影 OP 指向北，说明该日太阳在南侧；长影 OQ 指向南，说明另一至日太阳在北侧，这符合南半球低纬地区的情况。因此当地纬度为 11°S。
